## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vedanāttika* ("The Triad of Feelings") is a structural section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Nyanatiloka 1938]. In the systematic classification of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the *Vedanāttika* constitutes the second triad of the Abhidhamma mātikā, following the *Kusalattika* [Nyanatiloka 1938]. The material of this triad is systematically treated across analytical frameworks including chapters on conditionality, support (*nissaya-vāra*), conjunction (*saṃsaṭṭha-vāra*), association (*sampayutta-vāra*), and investigation (*pañha-vāra*) [Nyanatiloka 1938].
